headline: GTA 6 takes in $3.8bn in its first full day, a record
pages: Grand Theft Auto 6 brought in $3.8 billion in retail sales on its first full day, which Take-Two, the parent of Rockstar Games, said is a record for entertainment in any medium. The figures are estimates through the end of Thursday, and the company said it pre-sold 32.5 million copies. For comparison, this year's top-grossing film so far, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, earned $2.5 billion over its whole run in cinemas. Cloudflare reported that PlayStation 5 downloads in the UK peaked at 8.6 times normal levels around launch, and traffic to Rockstar's online services peaked at 11.2 times normal in Australia.

The game beat the first-week record set 13 years ago by Grand Theft Auto V, which earned $1.15 billion in five days. Why it matters: the launch shows how large video games have become as an entertainment business. Source: BBC.
